methodological_rigor.justification: Retrospective single-site analysis of EndoPredict test results in patient cohort. No external validation. Standard statistical analysis with chi-square tests. Limited sample size documentation. No adjustment for confounders. Adequate but not rigorous.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: Practical clinical question: factors influencing high-risk classification by EndoPredict in endometrial cancer. Directly applicable to clinical practice for risk stratification and treatment planning.

reporting_quality.justification: Methods adequately described. STROBE elements partially addressed. No data availability statement. Patient-level data not accessible.

novelty_literature.justification: Application of existing EndoPredict test in local cohort. No novel methodology, biomarkers, or biological insights. Confirmatory analysis only.

writing_presentation.justification: Clearly written with appropriate tables and figures. Results logically presented. Discussion contextualizes within EndoPredict literature.

key_strengths: Practical analysis of EndoPredict utility in real-world clinical context
Clear identification of factors influencing high-risk classification
key_concerns: Single-center retrospective design without external validation
Limited novelty; application of existing test only
No mechanistic insights or biological advancement
chief_reviewer.rationale: Competent practical analysis suitable for institutional quality improvement but lacks external validation and novelty for high-tier publication. Tier 4 appropriate with major revisions.
